description:
Save a message attachment (video, image, audio, document) to a local file and return its path. By default it goes to a new file in the addon's download folder; writing elsewhere (outputPath) needs the user's confirmation. Identify it with `url` (an mxc:// or localmxc:// URL, or a beeper-mcp://attachments/... URI as returned by the official Beeper MCP), or with `chatID` + `messageID` (+ `index` when a message has several attachments).
Batch: with `chatID` + `since` (+ `until`) instead of a message, it saves every photo and video (or `mediaTypes`) of that chat in that period into one folder, oldest first, named by date and message ID, and returns one short line per file (time, sender, message ID → file name). At most `maxFiles` per call (default 30): `nextSince` gives where to continue. Files already in the folder are skipped, so a repeated call only fetches what is missing.

chatID.description: Chat ID (or local chat ID) of the message, or of the chat to download from (batch)

maxFiles.description: Batch: at most this many files per call (default 30)

mediaTypes.description: Batch: which kinds (default ["image", "video"]; "file" = documents, audio…). Stickers are skipped

messageID.description: ID of the message holding the attachment

outputDir.description: Batch: folder to save into (confirm with the user first). Default: one folder per chat in /tmp/churn-mlhvcybn/.cache/beeper-mcp-addon/downloads

outputPath.description: Where to save the file (confirm with the user first). Defaults to a new file in /tmp/churn-mlhvcybn/.cache/beeper-mcp-addon/downloads

overwrite.description: Replace outputPath if it already exists (default false). Replaces the user's file: confirm first

since.description: Batch: ISO time; download the chat's media sent from then on (inclusive)

until.description: Batch: ISO time; only media sent before it. Default: now

name: download_attachment
title: Download Beeper attachments
